red_check.note: red letters read on the master at 1.4-2.5x; one per sign, all 49 legible

verdict: consistent with a two-letter sign: 49 signs = 49 letters, 11 groups = 11 words; 15 of 17 shapes take one letter; V writes ا (6) and د (3), and the hook ﺞ writes ب (4) and the ي of العشيه (1), both as the record's style note says; letter 90.7%, skeleton 93.0% over repeated shapes because of V. Red gloss 48/49 by letter, 49/49 by skeleton.
notes: Enciphered part only: النهار قد طلبه فاقبل العبد نحوكم عجلا فلم يجدكم فقبل العشيه (the last 11 of the 19 words of 37r l.6-7). Counts by eye 12, 15, 14, 8 = 49, as the record.
فقبل (record correction from فقيل) is confirmed by the cipher: its third sign is the ب-hook ﺞ, and the red over it is a bar with one dot below (ب).

The red over the ي of العشيه is also a bar with one dot below (ب form) over the same hook sign: the glosser wrote the sign's usual value, so this is the one letter-level disagreement (skeleton agrees). The record's gloss list gives ي there and ي for فقبل's ب: both are ب-form in red on the master.
The red over ⊔ in النهار is a small loop (ں), read ن (the same sign is ن with a clear red ن in نحوكم).
Look-alike check: the three ق signs (l.1, l.2, l.3) are the same stem-with-left-loop; V for ا and V for د are not distinguishable by eye.
